snippet.title: Star Lane First Official Trailer | Zodiac Roguelike for Mobile
snippet.description:
Star Lane is a 2D pixel-art roguelike for Android developed by Lab Lasagna.

Navigate 12 zodiac-themed corridors across 4 elements (Fire, Earth, Air and Water). 67 items, a skill tree with permanent upgrades, and an infinite Loop mode after completing all 12 signs.

Music by Metatryptic :
https://open.spotify.com/intl-es/artist/0Nu1WwFoAgMkAMNZdZeGMJ
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCT7lx8wMcF_4KZdVKGTd47Q

Developed by Lab Lasagna.
Follow development:
Instagram: instagram.com/lab_lasagna
TikTok: tiktok.com/@lab_lasagna
